statement.zh: Firth 与 Quibell《Excavations at Saqqara: The Step Pyramid》(1935，含 Lauer 平面) 正式报告左塞尔阶梯金字塔建筑群发掘。
statement.en: Firth and Quibell’s Excavations at Saqqara: The Step Pyramid (1935, with Lauer plans) formally reports excavation of the Djoser Step Pyramid complex.

editorial.notes: Density pass D-2026-10-11-22; fact claims cite registered sources only.
